# Customer Complaint Follow-Up: Order 184
Meadowlark Counter & Grill | 06/18/2026

## Order record
Customer: Keiko Castillo
Order: 184, placed at 12:02 PM at the Brookfield counter
Promise time: 12:08 PM
Payment: $15.41, paid by card

| Item | Quantity | Price |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Chicken sandwich | 1 | $8.49 |
| Small fries | 1 | $3.29 |
| Unsweetened iced tea, 20 oz | 1 | $2.49 |
| Subtotal | | $14.27 |
| Sales tax | | $1.14 |
| Total | | $15.41 |

Paul Ramos verified the receipt at 12:26 PM. The card charge matches the receipt total.

## Customer reply sent by Tyrone Ibrahim at 12:31 PM
Hi Keiko,

I'm sorry your pickup took longer than expected. Your drink was a 20-oz lemonade, and we appreciate you letting us know about the order. The card charge matches your receipt total, so no payment adjustment is needed.

The pickup screen records the order as ready at 12:19 PM, and the receipt shows handoff at 12:21 PM. Since the promised pickup time was 12:08 PM, the order was handed over on time. We have reminded the team to verify pickup times and communicate delays clearly.

Please reply to this message if you have any other concerns about your order. Thank you for giving us the opportunity to make this right.

Tyrone Ibrahim
Shift lead, Meadowlark Counter & Grill

errors.explanation: The order record lists an unsweetened iced tea, 20 oz, not lemonade. The reply gives the customer an incorrect account of the item ordered.
errors.fix: Your drink was a 20-oz unsweetened iced tea

errors.quote: the order was handed over on time
errors.explanation: The promised time was 12:08 PM, but the receipt records handoff at 12:21 PM, 13 minutes later. The conclusion that the order was on time does not follow from the timeline.
errors.fix: the order was handed over 13 minutes late
